name: Tata Consultancy Services
summary: Historical FY2025 evidence: TCS reported 4.2% constant-currency revenue growth and 24.3% operating margin. Its AI workforce ambition cannot be scored from employee training counts alone.

findings.title: Annual growth and profitability are documented
findings.body: The FY2025 earnings call reports 4.2% constant-currency revenue growth, 24.3% operating margin and 19% net margin.

findings.title: AI ambition has an evidence gap
findings.body: In July 2024, management aimed to build the world’s largest AI-ready workforce. The annual report records over 100,000 employees acquiring higher-order AI/ML and GenAI skills, but supplies no comparable global ranking.

findings.title: Hiring is an outcome, not proof of an earlier target
findings.body: The annual report records 42,000 freshers hired during FY2025. The selected evidence set does not establish an earlier numeric hiring commitment, so this outcome is not scored as a promise kept.

findings.title: Orders are a separate measure from revenue
findings.body: The FY2025 call reports Q4 total contract value of US$12.2 billion. A signed-order measure does not establish when revenue will be recognized.

commitments.statement: On 11 July 2024, management stated an ambition to build the largest AI-ready workforce through employee reskilling.
commitments.target: World’s largest AI-ready workforce; no deadline or common measurement supplied
commitments.observed: Annual report: 100,000+ acquired higher-order AI/ML and GenAI skills in FY2025
commitments.reason: The report shows skilling activity, but no peer comparison or common definition establishes the superlative. No met/missed verdict is justified.

sources.title: Q1 FY2025 earnings call · 11 July 2024
sources.excerpt: We plan to build the largest AI-ready workforce in the world, by organically reskilling our employees.

sources.title: Q4 FY2025 earnings call · 10 April 2025
sources.excerpt: Our financial year 2025 revenue grew by 4.2% in constant currency.

warnings: Historical example for the year ended 31 March 2025; sources checked on 11 November 2026. This is not the latest company result.
Extractive, manually verified evidence; no model-generated analysis. Aspirations without comparable outcomes remain unclear.
No numeric annual revenue guidance comparison is inferred. The selected transcripts do not establish a measurable revenue commitment.
